summary: The team is in a critical push to fix a locked Outlook account while simultaneously driving the China-focused marketing strategy for Asia Star and Intelligent China, with immediate follow-ups from the Tech in Asia conference and final design decisions for the knowledge website due this week.
summaryDetail: The most urgent issue is resolving the Outlook account lockout: all team members must delete and re-login on all devices, and contact JSB to confirm the unlock. In parallel, the China-first marketing strategy is in full swing, with Asia Star and Intelligent China prioritized for SEO and content, and the Intelligent China webpage being split into three modules (Module 1: Beijing, Dec 1–4, EV & Intelligent Mobility). This week, Joseph must share the HTML design file and meet with Julie and Joker to finalize feedback for the knowledge website, which will combine elements from both design versions and feature BCI/BSI indices on the homepage. Upcoming tasks include Joseph’s October priorities for website, SEM/SEO, GEO, and content, as well as Ben and Jay creating touch points for Tech in Asia attendees and confirming Asia Start spotlight video timelines.
